{{Quote|I'm a soldier, like you. This is what I was bred for.|99|audio=ThisIsWhatIWasBredFor-ARCT.flac|<ref name=":0">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''99''' was a disabled [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] who served the cloning facilities and performed [[Janitor/Legends|janitorial]] duties at [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He died during the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|99, would you please send a cleaning crew to the training ground.''"<br />"''Yes, Mistress. We'll take care of the mess.|Shaak Ti and 99 after Domino Squad's training exercise|audio=ComeCleanUp-CC.flac|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:99AtWork-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|99 at work carrying weapons.]]
99 was a disabled clone with limited mobility and overly rapid aging. He was therefore deemed unfit for service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was assigned to perform janitorial duties in [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] cloning facilities. He befriended the members of [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]]&mdash;[[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]] [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]], [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]] and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]]&mdash;during their final exam to become [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. However, Domino Squad lacked proper teamwork, which caused it to fail the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]].

Though [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] decided to give Domino Squad a second chance, 99 later caught Hevy attempting to go absent without leave in the middle of the night. 99 pleaded with Hevy not to leave and taught him the importance of teamwork and brotherhood. Deciding to take 99's advice and name to heart, Hevy led his squad to finish its final exam. Later, in gratitude for his inspiring words, Hevy decided to give his graduation medal to 99, with the promise that they would meet again. However, Hevy would later sacrifice himself to destroy Rishi Outpost and prevent an invasion of Kamino, which 99 would learn when Echo and Fives returned to Kamino.

During an attack launched against [[Tipoca City]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], 99 assisted clone troopers Echo, Fives, and a group of cadets against the invading [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] forces. This included bringing them fresh blasters and grenades for resupply. 99's in-depth knowledge of the facility became useful when a group of junior cadets became separated from their group, allowing him to lead them on the quickest route to the relative safety of the barracks.

After meeting with [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]] and [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]], 99 assisted the [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] in defending the [[City/Legends|city]]. 99 was shot and killed by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] while attempting to retrieve explosives for use in combating the droids. He was fully aware that he was risking his life to do so, due to his limited mobility. Once the Confederacy was pushed back, 99 was mourned by his brothers and commended as a true soldier.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We lost a true soldier.''"<br />"''He really was one of us.|Commander Cody and Captain Rex mourning 99|audio=OneOfUs-ARCT.flac|<ref name=":0" />}}
[[File:99Dead-ARCT.png|thumb|left|220px|Rex, Cody, Fives and Echo mourn 99's death.]]
99 was a kind, gentle, compassionate, dedicated and loyal member of the maintenance division of the Grand Army of the Republic, but was often looked down upon because of his deformity&mdash;while 99 always respected his brothers. 99 was also a source of wisdom and was able to develop a deep friendship with Hevy and the other members of Domino Squad after talking him out of going AWOL.<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>

Despite his limitations&mdash;which included a walking disability&mdash;99 was proud of his basic soldier's heritage which his brothers were able to execute, and was determined to be useful in combat. When Kamino was invaded by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, 99 helped as best he could by delivering needed weaponry to the clone troopers. He also wanted to prove himself as a soldier like his brothers, seen when he risked his life to try and retrieve more grenades but was shot and killed instead.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
99 was created for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was first featured on an online assortment of trading cards on the website [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Card" /> and debuted in the episodes "[[Clone Cadets]]" and "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]," both of which premiered on [[September 17]], [[2010]]. 99 was voiced by actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provides voicework for most of the series' clone characters.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref>
